rules.rule: When code added in this PR cannot work as written or does not belong in it (an unrun harness, a speculative path, work unrelated to the stated change), recommend removing it. Do not suggest building more code to make it work.
Flag changes the PR description does not mention, such as new vendor or provider presets, dependencies, test runners, environment variables, or edits to shared tooling.
Shared test, fixture, and screenshot tooling must not gain feature-specific flags, modes, runners, or fake upstream services to capture or test one screen.
